purpose: Append-oriented registry for exploratory subject-boundary analyses performed after inspection. This file is separate from the immutable confirmatory preregistration.

recurrent_autonomy_v1.scope: Natural multistep trajectories using the original six synthetic scenarios.
recurrent_autonomy_v1.metric: I((A_t,B_t);(A_t+1,B_t+1)|E_t), with local conditional-autonomy and state-entropy companions.
recurrent_autonomy_v1.research_integrity_note: Behavior of these measures was inspected during method development before this extension was documented. Observed contrasts must not be treated as preregistered confirmatory tests.
candidate_confounds: Reciprocal copying/permutation can make a joint process highly self-predictive without conjunctive representation.
Low-entropy attractors can make an interventionally joint system look weakly autonomous on naturally visited trajectories.
recurrent_autonomy_v1.next_confirmatory_requirement: Preregister held-out dynamics or scenario variants in a new immutable confirmatory artifact before using autonomy contrasts as confirmatory evidence.
